description: Land Acquisition - Melpitiya Naula D/S Division, Matale District
reasoning: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically serving notice of the government's intention to acquire a specific plot of land (Lot No. 1189, named Galbodawatte hena) for the Moragahakanda & Kaluganga Development Project. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, including the description of the property, its location, the public purpose for acquisition, and the process for claimants to seek compensation. It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
